validity.researcher_notes: EXISTENCE: started from the sheet's own wiki citations. The gem.wiki page for this row cites four PNGRB/tender documents; I fetched and read all of them directly rather than trusting the wiki's summary (standing rule 1 -- read for leads only). The single most important document is the sponsor's OWN regulatory filing: https://www.pngrb.gov.in/pdf/public-notice/EoI29092020.pdf, GSPL India Gasnet Limited's (GIGL) 17-Sep-2020 letter to PNGRB's Secretary, 'Submission of Expression of Interest (EOI) for Laying, Building and Operating Natural Gas Pipeline from Langtala (Jaisalmer District, Rajasthan) to Pachpadra (Barmer District, Rajasthan)', filed under PNGRB's NGPL Authorization Regulations 2008. This is a scanned/image PDF -- it 200s but has NO text layer at all (confirmed via both PyPDF2 and pdftotext, which both return empty strings for every page), so url_verifier's substring screen fails it on every token; I OCR'd all 11 pages myself (PyMuPDF render -> tesseract) and read the actual content directly, which is a stronger check than the automated screen, not a weaker one. The letter states verbatim: 'Focus Energy Limited is expecting production of 4 MMSCMD gas from its gas field in Langtala, Jaisalmer District. In order to connect the said gas source to the national gas grid... GIGL is hereby submitting Expression of Interest... The approximate length of the pipeline will be around 290 kms.' Schedule-A (page 3) gives Point of Origin = 'Langtala, Jaisalmer District, Rajasthan' and End Point = 'Pachpadra in Barmer District, Rajasthan'. Independently, PNGRB's own tender portal page (https://www.pngrb.gov.in/eng-web/ng-bid-16.html, url_verifier OK on 'Langtala'+'Pachpadra') lists 'Langtala - Pachpadra Natural Gas Pipeline (LPPL)', Tender Reference BID/NGPL/16/2020/01/LPPL/01 dated 27.11.2020, with a full corrigendum history (25.03.2021 through 26.04.2022) and finally 'Public Notice for Annulment of Bid No. BID/NGPL/16/2020/01/LPPL, Updated Date: 05.05.2022'. Two genuinely independent origins -- the private/state sponsor company (GIGL) and the regulator (PNGRB) -- agree this was a real, formally-bid pipeline project, not a GEM-only or hallucinated entity. Existence: confirmed, high tier. CLASSIFICATION: 'transmission' is correct, not gathering/CGD. GIGL is not the field operator (Focus Energy Limited owns the Langtala gas field); GIGL is the transmission-pipeline company (the same EOI letter notes GIGL had already commissioned 442 km of trunk pipeline and was building a further 936-km 'MBPL' system), applying under PNGRB's cross-country Natural Gas Pipeline (NGPL) Authorization Regulations -- the common-carrier trunk-pipeline framework, distinct from the CGD Authorization Regulations that govern city-gas/distribution networks. This is an inter-connector line tying a single new field into the national trunk grid, the same 'transmission not gathering' pattern found on the sibling Kakinada-Vizag-Srikakulam row (P0932) audited earlier in this batch. DUPLICATE CHECK vs roster: P0936 (Langtala-Bhilwara, 580 km, 1.83 MMSCMD) and P2215 (Langtala-Jodhpur-Pali, 440 km, 5.0 MMSCMD) share the same Langtala origin point as P2748 (290 km, 4.0 MMSCMD), but each has a DIFFERENT destination, a DIFFERENT capacity, and P2748 specifically corresponds to PNGRB tender bid16/LPPL -- a distinct, separately-numbered bid process from the other two (which the EOI and tender-portal evidence here does not touch). The EOI explicitly ties P2748's exact capacity (4 MMSCMD) to the exact Langtala gas field's expected output as reported by its operator (Focus Energy Limited) -- there is no indication in anything I read that this is the same physical corridor as either sibling row under another name. Reading as three separate corridor options PNGRB put to bid for evacuating the same stranded-gas area (a normal PNGRB practice), not one project recorded three times. I did not independently re-verify P0936/P2215's own tender numbers (out of scope for this row), so this is a caveat, not a closed finding -- flag for whoever audits those two rows. ATTRIBUTION: Owner1='GIGL' is correct and unambiguous -- the EOI is GIGL's own filing, self-identifying as 'GSPL India Gasnet Limited (GIGL)', a Government of Gujarat undertaking (Companies Act company, CIN U40200GJ2011SGC067449), submitting alone with no JV partner ('Not Applicable as GIGL meets the criteria on its own') -- corroborates the sheet's Owner1%=100.00%. SPEC: LengthKnown=290 km matches the EOI's own approximate figure ('around 290 kms') exactly. Capacity=4.00 MMSCMD matches the EOI's stated field output (4 MMSCMD from Focus Energy's Langtala field) exactly. StartLocation/StartPrefecture/StartState and EndLocation/EndState all match the EOI's Schedule-A origin/end-point fields exactly (Langtala, Jaisalmer District, Rajasthan -> Pachpadra, Barmer District, Rajasthan). No diameter is recorded on the sheet and none is given in the EOI or any other document I could read -- correctly left blank rather than guessed.

fills.researcher_notes: EoI29092020.pdf is a scanned/image PDF -- url_verifier FAILs it on every token because it has no extractable text layer at all (confirmed via PyPDF2 and pdftotext, both empty). I OCR'd it myself (PyMuPDF + tesseract) and it repeatedly says 'Natural Gas Pipeline' and '4 MMSCMD gas'; the automated 'ok: false' reflects the extraction limitation, not the content. ng-bid-16.html independently and automatically confirms 'Natural Gas' in the tender title ('NG PIPELINE ONLINE BIDDING Langtala - Pachpadra Natural Gas Pipeline (LPPL)').

Neither source uses the literal word 'transmission', but both make the classification unambiguous by context: the EoI (OCR-confirmed, automated screen fails on this image PDF as noted on the Fuel fill) is filed under PNGRB's cross-country Natural Gas Pipeline (NGPL) Authorization Regulations 2008 -- the common-carrier trunk-pipeline framework -- by GIGL, a transmission-pipeline company (self-described as having commissioned 442 km and building a further 936 km of trunk pipeline), to connect a single field's gas 'to the national gas grid'. PNGRB's own tender portal (ng-bid-16.html) categorizes it under 'NG Pipeline Online Bidding', the NGPL bid track, distinct from PNGRB's separate CGD (city gas distribution) authorization process. An inter-connector trunk line into the national grid, not a gathering/CGD line.

The sponsor's own EOI letter (OCR-confirmed, per the Fuel fill's note on why url_verifier fails this image PDF) states verbatim: 'Focus Energy Limited is expecting production of 4 MMSCMD gas from its gas field in Langtala, Jaisalmer District.' This is the primary regulatory filing that is the origin of the whole project and matches GEM's Capacity=4.00 MMSCMD exactly. Per confidence_tiers.md, one primary/regulatory source is sufficient for high tier; I found no second, independently-stated capacity figure (PNGRB's tender portal page does not state a capacity number), so I am not claiming 2+ independent corroboration, just the strongest single-source case the rubric recognizes.

Same EOI letter (OCR-confirmed): 'The approximate length of the pipeline will be around 290 kms.' Matches GEM's LengthKnown=290 km exactly (the sheet correctly does not overstate the '290' as more precise than the source's own 'approximate ... around' framing). No second source states a length figure, so single-source high tier per the primary-regulatory-filing rule, same caveat as the Capacity fill.

The EOI's Schedule-A (OCR-confirmed) states Point of Origin = 'Langtala, Jaisalmer District, Rajasthan' and End Point = 'Pachpadra in Barmer District, Rajasthan' -- matches every GEM location field exactly (the sheet does not carry an EndPrefecture/District column for this row, consistent with the schema convention seen on other rows in this batch). PNGRB's tender portal page independently confirms the place names Langtala and Pachpadra (url_verifier OK). Note: Pachpadra's own district (Barmer) is only confirmed by the single EOI source, not independently by the tender page, so treat that one sub-fact as medium if isolated -- the overall location set is high given the EOI+tender-page agreement on the two place names and the internal consistency of the EOI's own district/state pairing.

The EOI (OCR-confirmed) is GIGL's own filing, self-identifying as 'GSPL India Gasnet Limited (GIGL)', a Government of Gujarat undertaking (Companies Act company, CIN U40200GJ2011SGC067449), submitted alone with no joint-venture partner ('Not Applicable as GIGL meets the criteria at (i) above on its own') -- confirms both the Owner1='GIGL' abbreviation and the 100% single-ownership share. Primary-source self-identification, high tier.

status_reviews.researcher_notes: This is a CONFIRMED cancellation, not a dormancy inference -- closes one of the 8 blank-ShelvedCancelledType rows in this cluster. The sheet's own cited ref, APN05052022.pdf, is a 200 but url_verifier FAILs its 'cancelled'/'Langtala'/'Pachpadra' substring checks because the automated PDF-text extraction misses this document's content (I confirmed with PyPDF2, which extracts it cleanly -- it is NOT an image PDF, unlike the EOI; this looks like a screen artifact on this particular extractor/file, per url_verifier.py's own documented false-negative caveats). Reading the extracted text directly: 'With respect to the bid invited by Petroleum and Natural Gas Regulatory Board for the development of Langtala - Pachpadra Natural Gas Pipeline (Bid No.: BID/NGPL/16/2020/01/LPPL), it has been decided to annul the entire bidding process under Clause 4 and 31.3 of Application-cum-Bid Document floated for the said bidding process. PNGRB is evaluating other options of the pipeline infrastructure to evacuate the gas from the se fields.' Dated 5 May 2022 (PNGRB/Auth/2-NGPL(14)/2020). PNGRB's own tender portal page (ng-bid-16.html, url_verifier OK) independently lists the same event: 'Public Notice for Annulment of Bid No. BID/NGPL/16/2020/01/LPPL, Updated Date: 05.05.2022, Annulment Public Notice' -- two documents from the regulator itself, consistent on the date and bid number, so this is as solid a confirmed-cancellation source as this dataset gets: the regulator formally annulling the entire bidding process for this specific named pipeline is a textbook 'confirmed' cancellation, not an inferred dormancy call. CancelledYear=2022 already matches the notice date exactly -- no change needed there. Searched for any later evidence that PNGRB revived this specific corridor (a successor re-bid, a different sponsor picking it up, or the Langtala field's gas being evacuated another way) and found none in anything read for this row; the tender portal's own history for BID/NGPL/16/2020/01/LPPL ends at the annulment notice with no subsequent re-bid entry under that reference. 'cancelled' remains the correct, now fully-sourced status; recommend setting ShelvedCancelledType='confirmed' with this ref.

summary: P2748 Langtala-Pachpadra Gas Pipeline confirmed real (sponsor GIGL's own 2020 PNGRB EOI + PNGRB's tender portal), correctly classified transmission, not a duplicate of the sibling Langtala-Bhilwara/Langtala-Jodhpur-Pali rows (different destinations/capacities/bid numbers), and Length/Capacity/Owner/Location all match the EOI exactly -- refs added to all six previously-unsourced fields. Cancellation is CONFIRMED (PNGRB's own 5-May-2022 notice formally annulling Bid BID/NGPL/16/2020/01/LPPL), so ShelvedCancelledType should move from blank to 'confirmed'.
